== examples/big/fact.oro windows refused
   gen: fact: acc needs arbitrary precision — int 0 +inf is above the word of target windows, [-9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807] — and the target declares none.
     Go has math/big, the JVM has BigInteger and V8 has BigInt, so those three parasitize the host's own. A target without one needs a bignum WRITTEN, in Oroboros, the way win/map is (ADR 0019, docs/unbounded-rung.md).

== examples/int/collatz.oro go refused
   note: gen-collatz: 0 of 4 integer operations bounded; 0 of 1 loop(s) proven terminating
   gen: gen-collatz: 4 of 4 integer operation(s) cannot be proven to stay inside the word of target go, [-9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807] and [0, 18446744073709551615]
     go.* [-inf, +inf] in (go.* 3 x)
     go.+ [-inf, +inf] in (go.+ (go.* 3 x) 1)
     go.+ [1, +inf] in (go.+ steps 1)
     … and 1 more
     Outside its word a target's arithmetic does not compute the integer the
     program means — Go, the JVM and x86 wrap, JavaScript loses precision — so
     this is refused rather than noted (ADR 0019, ADR 0026).
     Clear it by saying one of:
       · NARROW THE RANGE — `(sig f ((n (int 0 1000))) …)`, or a `(where …)`,
         so the operation is provably in range;
       · ASK FOR THE TRAP — build with `-checked`, which emits the target's
         own checked arithmetic and fails at run time instead.

== examples/kara/core.oro go refused
   note: gen-run: 9 of 12 integer operations bounded; 4 of 4 loop(s) proven terminating
   gen: gen-run: 3 of 12 integer operation(s) cannot be proven to stay inside the word of target go, [-9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807] and [0, 18446744073709551615]
     go.* [-inf, +inf] in (go.* acc 100)
     go.+ [-inf, +inf] in (go.+ (go.* acc 100) (p i))
     go.+ [0, +inf] in (go.+ (out3 (let (go.+ i j) (fn (k) (if (go.< k 0) 0 (if (go....
     Outside its word a target's arithmetic does not compute the integer the
     program means — Go, the JVM and x86 wrap, JavaScript loses precision — so
     this is refused rather than noted (ADR 0019, ADR 0026).
     Clear it by saying one of:
       · NARROW THE RANGE — `(sig f ((n (int 0 1000))) …)`, or a `(where …)`,
         so the operation is provably in range;
       · ASK FOR THE TRAP — build with `-checked`, which emits the target's
         own checked arithmetic and fails at run time instead.
